blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: First passenger train ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on April 16, 1853.
Indian Railways is divided into administrative divisions across 19 zones.
CBT exams in RRB carry negative marking of 1/3rd mark for every wrong answer.
General Science and Current Affairs constitute a significant portion of RRB NTPC & Group D papers.
Match the following questions on Railway Zone Headquarters are frequently featured.
Lord Dalhousie is known as the Father of Indian Railways.
Broad Gauge width (1.676 m) is a recurring question in RRB technical and non-technical exams.

blocks.content: Fundamental Rights are contained in Part III of the Indian Constitution (Articles 12 to 35). They are called 'Fundamental' because they are essential for the all-round development of individuals and are enforceable by courts.
